info.title: SecureVOTE API
info.description: Educational/research prototype of an embedded electronic-voting and election-integrity pipeline. This is NOT production election infrastructure. See /docs for the interactive API explorer.

post.description: Authenticate and receive a JWT access token.

Generate a short-lived (60s), single-use ticket for WebSocket authentication.
Prevents passing long-lived JWTs in URL query parameters.
Can be scoped to a specific election_id or global (None).
Create a new election. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Get election details with candidates and device count.

post.description: Add candidates to an election. Requires ADMIN role.

schema.title: Response Add Candidates Api Elections  Election Id  Candidates Post
Response Get Candidates Api Elections  Election Id  Candidates Get

patch.description: Change election state. Enforces strict state machine transitions. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description:
Export complete election archive for offline independent machine verification.
Contains raw candidates, devices, ballots, audit entries, and cryptographic manifest.

post.description: Authorize a voting session. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: List all voting sessions for an election. Requires ADMIN or AUDITOR role.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Elections  Election Id  Sessions Get

post.description:
Cast a vote. Authenticated by session_token, not JWT.

The session_token serves as the simulated credential/session
authorization for this educational prototype.
Register a device for an election. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: List all devices for an election.

schema.title: Response List Devices Api Elections  Election Id  Devices Get

patch.description: Update device status. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Get paginated audit log for an election.

Independently verify the audit hash chain.

Recomputes every hash from raw record data â€” does NOT read any
precomputed verification flag.

Get election results with full independent verification.

This endpoint does NOT return cached results â€” it independently
recomputes tallies, verifies the audit chain, and runs reconciliation
every time it is called.

post.description:
Run full independent verification and generate/update result manifest.
Requires ADMIN or AUDITOR role.

get.description:
Retrieve active public key metadata for signature verification.
Never exposes private key material.

post.description:
Verify an Ed25519 digital signature against a JSON payload.
Uses provided public key, or the system active public key if omitted.

Digitally sign the Result Manifest of an election.
Enforces that election must be CLOSED or PUBLISHED with an EXACT_MATCH reconciliation.
Requires ADMIN or AUDITOR role.

get.description: Retrieve anchor commitment receipt by reference.

post.description:
Anchor the current audit root hash of an election.
Supports LOCAL and EXTERNAL providers.
Requires ADMIN or AUDITOR role.

get.description:
Verify that an anchor reference commits to an authentic audit root hash of the election.
If root_hash query param is provided, checks exact match.
Otherwise checks that the anchored root exists as a valid entry in the election's audit chain.

Evaluate deterministic anomaly rules against election audit and ballot data.
Returns advisory findings tagged 'REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW'.
Findings are strictly advisory and do NOT block or delay any election operations.

post.description:
Process an RFID card tap.

Computes a keyed pseudonym (HMAC-SHA256) for the raw UID.
The raw UID is NEVER logged, persisted, or returned.

Architectural Boundary:
Successful RFID authentication does NOT grant a ballot or voting session
unless the election is OPEN, device is ACTIVE, and voter has not already voted.

get.description:
List sample simulated card profiles for dashboard testing and demonstrations.
Does not expose private keys or raw UIDs of real credentials.
